## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (svelte-check + tsc, strict mode)
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes (prettier + eslint)
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] Manually exercised the affected route(s) in a browser (screenshot ≠ enough — click through the actual flow)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] No emoji / gradients / non-Apple-system colors introduced (see `CLAUDE.md` Style)
- [ ] If a route/keyboard shortcut changed, `CLAUDE.md`'s tables are updated to match
